# ELK layout runtime

Unmodified `elk.bundled.js` and `elk-worker.min.js` from **elkjs 0.12.0**.
Project and corresponding source: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/0.12.0
License: Eclipse Public License 2.0, supplied in `ELK-LICENSE.md`.

These committed assets allow GitHub Pages to serve the layout runtime and worker without a build step or a CDN. The npm development dependency and lockfile pin the source used for testing and vendor updates.
